data.narrative:
Anello Photonics is a Series B-2 stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $25M to date. The available comp universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, yielding a total of 10 comparable companies in the sector.

The Peer-Median method is not applicable to this valuation. Despite identifying 23 same-sector peers in Defense & Security, the dataset contains insufficient depth within narrow filters: zero companies at the same development stage, zero at adjacent stages, and zero within comparable valuation tier. This scarcity prevents the derivation of a statistically meaningful median without introducing material bias. An all-sector median would conflate early-stage photonics companies with later-stage or larger-scale defense players, misrepresenting market positioning.

Given the inapplicability of peer-median triangulation and the absence of alternative methodologies in the provided data, this analysis cannot produce a supported valuation range. A credible estimate would require either: expansion of the comp set to include adjacent-stage or slightly broader-sector peers with disclosed metrics, application of revenue multiple or DCF approaches using Anello-specific financial data, or acquisition precedent analysis within Defense & Security optics. The core constraint remains data availability rather than analytical framework.
